title: Pubspec that targets a non-default publication endpoint
description: pubspec.yaml declares a `publish_to` value that is not `none`. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `publish_to` value that is not `none`.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a `publish_to` value that is not `none`.
limitation: It matches a `publish_to` value that is not `none` in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
